column2: Doubles your current count for each soul. Max 30 soul gain per type.
Increase the number of souls you start with.
TOME SHOT (3 souls) - Launch 4 homing projectiles
TOME SEEK (3 souls) - Shoot a volley of 7 fast projectiles that mark enemies to drop their souls
TOME BOMB (3 souls) - Fire a powerful explosive
TOME SPEAR (3 souls) - Launch a powerful piercing projectile
TOME FIELD (3 souls) - Enemies within a radius will grant you a soul
TOME BUFF (3 souls) - Apply a useful effect to yourself
